Liqwall and TradRadar are separate publishers with overlapping venue aggregates; they do not represent independent underlying exchange universes.
XRP Insights ETF dashboard top-level week 46 flow conflicts with its detailed Nov 2-6 flow; retain both.
XRP Insights Evernorth wallet attribution is third-party analysis based on direct rippled reads; XRPSCAN transaction pages returned 403 during independent verification.
BNY/Ripple custody and tokenized-finance announcements distinguish live custody support from future plans subject to approvals.
Permission's official ASK documentation confirms a token used for AI/family rewards and agent-to-agent coordination, but no XRP integration; CoinMarketCap volume snapshots conflict sharply.
Kamilah Stevenson video attribution is supported by direct YouTube bylines and third-party transcript indexing; channel page is too large to inspect directly and legal identity is not verified.
